title: Untitled (Guernica with CDs)
description: Dense mixed-media collage populated by multiple iridescent compact discs distributed across a layered field of torn paper, red fragments, yellow vertical stripes, and grid-patterned material. Ohio State Buckeyes stickers, ink drips, and translucent plastic overlay a chaotic accumulation of collaged ephemera.
composition: scattered CDs over dense layered collage field
